result.one_liner: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is an open-source command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG/PNG/PDF files locally, with no hosted API or service.

evidence.quote: It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.

result.notes: Mermaid CLI is a local, open-source npm/Docker tool (mmdc) for rendering Mermaid diagrams; it has no hosted API, no auth, and no vendor MCP server. It should not be confused with 'Mermaid Chart' (mermaidchart.com), the separate commercial SaaS product that does have a hosted API and an official MCP server (which is what the precomputed composio/mcp leads actually point to). As an agent toolkit, Mermaid CLI is usable as a local shell/CLI skill (agents can shell out to mmdc to render diagrams) rather than as a hosted API integration — hence yellow/cli_not_api rather than red.
